project_type: Vite/React SPA (main app + landlord sub-app at src/landlord_agent) + NestJS v2 backend
build_system: npm workspaces; frontend: vite build; landlord sub-app: cd src/landlord_agent && npm install --include=dev && npm run build; backend: cd v2-backend && nest build; full: npm run build (from repo root — builds landlord sub-app, then Vite, then validates)
test_framework: vitest (backend: cd v2-backend && npm run test); no unit tests exist for the three files being changed
test_command: npm run typecheck (from repo root, fastest check covering all frontend files)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run typecheck` from repo root to catch all frontend TS errors. 2. Run `cd v2-backend && npm run build` to catch backend NestJS compile errors. 3. Run `npm run build` from repo root for a full production build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ (produced by npm run build). Do not commit dist/.
environment_constraints: Do not introduce new npm packages. Do not modify src/config/plans.ts, src/services/roleService.ts, or src/utils/roleIntent.ts.
contribution_requirements: No new npm packages. Preserve existing import styles (named imports, no default re-exports added). Both modals use inline styles for colours — stay consistent, do not introduce Tailwind hex classes for new colour values.
key_patterns: Both modals: state declared with useState<T> at top of component, useEffect resets state on open, handleUpgrade is an async function inside the component body, JSX footer is a div.px-6.py-4.border-t. billingService.ts (frontend): all functions are async named exports using fetchBillingWithApiFallback. billing.service.ts (backend): NestJS injectable service with private `this.stripe` getter and `this.db` getter; uses admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for timestamps.
directory_structure: repo root: src/ (main React app), src/landlord_agent/ (standalone Vite sub-app for landlord iframe), v2-backend/ (NestJS backend), .agents/tasks/ (plan/review artifacts)
